questions.q: What does the yellow circle on the Australian Aboriginal Flag represent?
questions.e: On the Aboriginal Flag, the black top half represents the Aboriginal peoples, the red bottom half represents the earth, and the yellow circle represents the sun.

questions.q: What is the white symbol in the centre of the Torres Strait Islander Flag?
questions.e: The white dancer's headdress is a symbol for all Torres Strait Islanders. The points of the white star represent the island groups.
